'''Jinyue''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk before opening the chest)
:'''Jinyue:''' Hmm... Umm... How do I open this box...
:'''{{DIcon}}''' What's the matter?
:'''Jinyue:''' Eh? No, nothing's wrong. Well, okay, something's wrong...
:'''Jinyue:''' It's this chest next to me. I found it after a lot of searching, but I can't open it.
:'''Jinyue:''' How about this, if you can open it, whatever is inside is yours!
----
;(Talk again)
:'''Jinyue:''' Do you think you can open it? If you can, whatever is inside should be rightfully yours!
:'''{{DIcon}}''' A chest?
::'''Jinyue:''' Yes, the chest right next to me.
::'''Jinyue:''' I've tried everything, but it's still locked tight.
::'''Jinyue:''' I love treasure hunting. I went through a lot to bring it back, but now  I can't get it open...
:'''{{DIcon}}''' You don't want what's in the chest?
::'''Jinyue:''' It's not that I don't want it, but if you can open it, I should give you a reward.
::'''Jinyue:''' I'm big on puzzles and treasure hunting. I found this chest that just won't open. I've been trying to unlock it for ages.
::'''Jinyue:''' But after all this time, I still can't get it open. I've lost interest in what's inside. I just want to see it open!
::'''Jinyue:''' So, if you can open this chest, whatever's inside is yours!
----
;(Talk after opening the chest)
:'''Jinyue:''' Impressive! You actually opened it!
:'''Jinyue:''' Now, spill the beans. How did you do it?
:'''Jinyue:''' I've been trying for ages... Using brute force to pry it open didn't work. Did you try kicking it?
:'''Jinyue:''' Or... or did you use some kind of Resonance ability?
----
:'''Jinyue:''' Alright. Time for a new puzzle. Where's the next one?
----
;(Day)
:'''Jinyue:''' How did you open that box? Tell me when you have a moment.
----
;(Night, first interaction)
:'''Jinyue:''' Didn't I also find a treasure map last time?
:'''Jinyue:''' Where did I put that treasure map...
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Treasure map?
:'''Jinyue:''' Yes, yes! I love solving puzzles and treasure hunting. Sometimes I find treasure maps just for fun.
:'''Jinyue:''' When I find the map I was looking for, I'll show it to you. Maybe you can solve what I couldn't!
----
:'''Jinyue:''' I'll tell you once I find the treasure map!
{{Dialogue End}}
